cache_aware_admission.scope: Measured clean inactive file cache can be reclaimed by the kernel. Shmem/dirty/writeback receive no credit; no global cache flush. Job RSS caps still apply.

sqlite.candidate_note: 3M same-input cache sweep verified logical identity; 128GiB is a capacity ceiling for the estimated100GiB full DB, not proof of full-scale speed or resident128GiB usage. Use fresh RSS headroom and runtime guards.

gpu.gpu_policy: Use available required GPUs for compatible kernels/training. Eight-GPU main training still requires user confirmation and numerical gates.

hardware.policy: Measured-container limits, not host core counts. Current memory includes reclaimable file cache. No global kernel/mount/GPU clock changes. Worker and memory budgets are planning values, not automatically enforced by arbitrary child commands.

scope: Readonly complete token prefetch/SHA against immutable native output records. Original F6 verification remains unchanged and mandatory. No cold/warm speed guarantee.
